notes: Settings now ends with More apps: UJournal, FamTM, My Hub and SideCut, each with what it does and a Get button that opens its Play listing. MeasureT is the fourth app in the other apps’ own lists, and it was still being called Compass EDC there.

The Android build now checks the certificate on the release APK against MeasureT’s upload certificate and fails if they differ. Before this it printed the certificate and passed whatever it found, so a keystore that Play would reject still produced files that looked ready to upload.
Nothing else changed — elevation, location, the level, the converter, currency, GPS measuring, the AR range finder, permissions and updates are exactly as they were.
